age.evidence: C57BL/6J adult male mice (Janvier, Le Genest-Saint-Isle, France)

sex.evidence: C57BL/6J adult male mice ... A total of 10 mice were dosed orally with either 3 mg/kg bodyweight psilocybin (n = 5) or saline solution (n = 5).

dosing.evidence: A total of 10 mice were dosed orally with either 3 mg/kg bodyweight psilocybin (n = 5) or saline solution (n = 5). ... compound administration via oral gavage

group_housing.evidence: maintained in littermate pairs in standard cages

day_night_flipped.evidence: The colony room was on a reversed light-dark cycle (dark phase 07:00 to 19:00) ... Dosing and blood sampling were conducted between 09:00 and 13:00.

enrichment_housing.evidence: standard cages (containing sawdust, a sleeping chamber, tissue paper, and a wood stick)

judge_notes: No behavioural assays were conducted. The only in vivo rodent work is oral psilocybin dosing followed by serial tail blood sampling for pharmacokinetics (baseline, 15, 30, 60, 120 min).
Dropped deepseek4's 'Blood sampling (pharmacokinetics)' assay. The rubric explicitly lists blood sampling and purely physiological measures as NOT assays. This exclusion agrees with qwen and gemma4.
The head-twitch response is mentioned only as prior work by Sherwood et al. (2020) in the Discussion. It was not performed in this study, so it is not scored.
Dosing vehicle set to not_reported. Saline was the control treatment, but the paper never states what psilocybin was dissolved in, so this overrides all three candidates (which said 'saline').
Reversed light cycle is confirmed: dark phase 07:00–19:00, with dosing and sampling at 09:00–13:00, which falls in the dark phase.
Home-cage enrichment is yes: the cages contained a sleeping chamber, tissue paper and a wood stick.
Remaining study-level metadata (species, strain, age, sex, dose, route, schedule, housing) were consistent across candidates and verified against Section 2.7 of the paper.
